verdicts.reason: Both are shrunk 320x50 strips with the same flaws: the legal fine print is promoted to a prominent left-hand block as large as secondary copy and crowds the tiny logo/can stack, and the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is shrunk to an illegible sliver under the headline. A's headline is smaller and breaks awkwardly ('...day of / the year...'), leaving loose dead space around it. B's headline is larger and dominant, but it presses up against the CTA and its ribbon is even more cramped, so B is only marginally better on hierarchy.
